title: Looking for people to test an AI prediction market built around X posts
author: Kind-Canary-37
selftext:
Hi everyone, we’re building Yap, an AI prediction market that lets people turn a question or an X post into a Yes or No market.

The product is now usable, but we need people who haven’t seen it before to tell us where it feels confusing.

We’re looking for 10 to 15 testers. Experience with prediction markets is not required. The test takes around 10 to 15 minutes:

1. Claim free testnet USDT
2. Create one or more markets on the website or by replying to an X post and tagging u/yapwtf
3. Place a test Yes or No trade
4. Tell us what was confusing, what broke, and which creation method felt more useful

This is testnet only. No real money, deposit, purchase, or positive review is required. Honest criticism is exactly what we need.

If you’re interested, comment below and I’ll share the test link and short feedback form.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
the creation flow is not where this breaks. resolution is. a yes or no market spun out of an X post inherits every bit of ambiguity that was in the post, and the arguments will all be about what counted.

worth deciding now whether the market creator writes the resolution criteria or you do. testers won't reach that in 15 minutes and it's the thing that kills these.
